mapper.select: SELECT hours.time, IFNULL( b.Count, 0 ) num FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d' ), INTERVAL ( -( @i := @i + 1 ) ) HOUR ), '%H' ) + 0 AS 'time' FROM ( SELECT a FROM ( SELECT '1' AS a UNION SELECT '2' UNION SELECT '3' UNION SELECT '4' ) AS a JOIN ( SELECT '1' UNION SELECT '2' UNION SELECT '3' UNION SELECT '4' UNION SELECT '5' UNION SELECT '6' ) AS b ON 1 ) AS b,( SELECT @i :=- 1 ) AS i ) hours LEFT JOIN ( SELECT HOUR ( e.flrc_fnsh_time ) AS HOUR, count(*) AS Count FROM T_FUEL_RECPT e WHERE e.flrc_date = #{date} AND e.flrc_airport_code = #{staffAirportCode} group by HOUR ( e.flrc_fnsh_time ) ORDER BY HOUR ( e.flrc_fnsh_time ) ) b ON hours.time = b.HOUR
